description: Corporate collection: HR workflows vs BEC and payroll fraud.

samples.message: Dear Team, the appraisal cycle starts next week. Please complete self-assessments on the HR portal by Friday. Best regards, HR Team.
Meeting invite: Project sync Friday 3 PM. Agenda: sprint review and release plan. Join via the calendar link. RSVP please.
Payslip for August is available on the HR portal. Form 16 will be released next month. Contact payroll for queries.
Tax invoice INV-2026-4821 from Sharma Traders, GSTIN 07ABCDE1234F1Z5. Amount due Rs.12,400 payable by 30th September.
This is the CEO. Confidential acquisition underway, keep this between us. Transfer Rs.5,00,000 to the vendor immediately. Do not call.
Dear vendor, our bank details changed for future invoices. Transfer pending Rs.2,40,000 to the new account today. Authorized by the finance head.
Your employment offer for Junior Accountant is attached. Joining date 1st October. Report to the HR desk with originals.
Congratulations! You are selected for a work-from-home job with Rs.60,000 salary. Pay Rs.1,999 training fee to confirm your seat today.
IT maintenance on Saturday 10 PM to Sunday 2 AM. VPN and email may be unavailable. Contact helpdesk for urgent access.
HR verification: share your login password and OTP on this link to keep your employee account active. Action within 1 hour.
